ideas.pitch: A localized, containerized Attack and Defense simulation sandbox designed specifically to automate flag retrieval and infrastructure hardening during live CTF matches.
ideas.problem_statement: Ghost Protocol CTF 2.0 Offline Grand Finale combining Jeopardy-style CTF and an Attack & Defense round.
ideas.title: AegisNode
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Attack & Defense round mechanics by offering automated vulnerability patch generation and automated defense scripts, giving teams an immediate tactical edge in the finale.

ideas.pitch: An automated metadata and digital footprint correlation engine for OSINT challenges that aggregates leaked credentials, image geolocation proofs, and domain historical records.
ideas.problem_statement: Ghost Protocol CTF 2.0 modern cybersecurity challenges involving OSINT and digital forensics.
ideas.title: OSINT-Trace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the tedious manual search bottleneck in OSINT challenges by running multi-source parallel queries, matching the winning pattern of leveraging automated data pipelines.

ideas.pitch: An automated cryptographic challenge analyzer that rapidly identifies flawed cipher implementations, weak RSA exponent patterns, and custom XOR/substitution schemes.
ideas.problem_statement: Ghost Protocol CTF 2.0 cryptography and reverse engineering challenges.
ideas.title: CryptoSleuth
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies hard backend engineering to automate mathematical crypto breaks that typically waste valuable competition hours during a timed CTF.

ideas.problem_statement: Ghost Protocol CTF 2.0 modern cybersecurity challenges and ethical hacking.
ideas.title: SecureGuard Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages advanced defense-in-depth architecture patterns from recent winning entries to address modern AI security vulnerabilities.

ideas.pitch: A zero-knowledge, biometric-authenticated offline document locker designed for secure forensic artifact and flag storage during live competitions.
